status: synthetic conformance architecture only; no production promotion
purpose: Exercise the full plural-authority chain as one bounded scenario and detect semantic mismatches between recognition, disclosure, assurance, policy conflict, explanation, challenge, reassessment, and reversible-pilot layers.
invariants: every stage references the same scenario and action lineage
a deny/hold at an earlier stage cannot become allow at a later stage without an explicit new evaluation
authority_effect must remain none for all evidence/explanation/reassessment/pilot records
unknown assurance must remain visible in explanation
disclosure may narrow recognition but recognition may not widen disclosure
challenge and reassessment append to the lineage and never rewrite earlier state
pilot success cannot promote production or consequential use
cross-stage contradictions fail the conformance scenario
nonclaims: This harness does not replace component tests.
This harness does not establish production readiness.
This harness does not create authority.
Synthetic success does not substitute for authentic pilot evidence.
